title: the spine on two real claims: an algebra with laws, and the first claims about this repository
intent: Automation is built on one real claim, not on an empty queue: a queue with no load does not test the format, and a method with no claim measures nothing. So the spine - the wave format, the queue, the executor - was carried by two claims about this repository, and generalised from what that slice forced into existence.
objection: каждая проверка запускается целиком, и один упавший тест останавливает остальные: сигнал получается шумным
refuted_by: проверки запускаются по одной, и падение одной не мешает остальным
